Prevention: Plant certified seed that is free of late blight (from

Select site with good drainage and avoid fields bordered by trees and dense vegetation; Weeding to reduce moisture around the plant; Eradication of source of inoculum by removing plant residues; Respect planting time (September to
B); Harvesting at suitable time; Earthing; Water management; Rotate with maize, wheat, or beans after each season
Wash field equipment and machinery after use
Avoid free movement of animals in the field
Solanum weeds as secondary source of inoculum.
Follow phytosanitary regulations on movement of planting materials
Before you see symptoms you can spray fungicide (Metalaxyl to prevent the disease) - See yellow direct control
For avoiding serious build up of disease, choose early maturing variety
NPK 17-17-17) to avoid too much nitrogen fertilizer as this may increase the vegetative growth, and consequently delay the time to crop maturity.
Monitoring: Inspect the field frequently (every two/ three days after sprouting)
The first symptoms are small light to dark green, circular to irregular- shaped water-soaked spots.
These lesions usually appear first on the lower leaves.
Lesions often begin to develop near the leaf tips or edges, where dew is retained the longest.
Examine also the white mycelium on the underside of the leaf and stems throughout the canopy.
Act immediately when first symptoms are noticed
Direct Control: Cut off stems three weeks before harvesting for reducing the infection of tubers
Restrictions: Wear full protective clothing such as a long
sleeved shirt, long pants, rubber gloves, boots, glasses, etc.
Do not allow product to enter the waterways or sewer
Do not smoke, drink, eat and chew anything while spraying and store away from foodstuffs, empty foodstuffs containers and animals feed
Chemical sprayers and mix tanks have to be cleaned in designated areas
Systemic; Rate of application: 40-50g/20L of water
II (moderately hazardous); 1 to 2 times until harvesting; PHI 7 days.
U (Unlikely to present acute hazard in normal use); Mode of action: contact; PHI 7 days.
